title: Mustard Twist Dress
prompt: A vertical studio fashion portrait of an original young woman with long, wavy copper-red hair falling past her shoulders, standing against a plain white seamless backdrop. She wears a mustard-yellow long-sleeved bodycon mini dress with a high mandarin-style collar, a small ring-shaped cutout at the neckline, an asymmetrical cross-over bodice with a twisted front knot, and softly ruched fabric along the sides. The sleeves are long and slightly flared at the wrists, with silver rings on her fingers. She holds a pale pink structured handbag by its strap. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio lighting with minimal shadow, a warm, saturated palette of mustard, ochre, and copper against neutral white. Bold, retro, and editorial, in the style of a 1970s-inspired fashion campaign.
workingNotes:
- The twisted bodice and ruching are the defining details; name them specifically.
- Mustard works best against a plain backdrop, so keep the background minimal.
tryThis: Try this: Use a plain backdrop to emphasize the mustard dress.
